findings.reason: Confirmed: V2 canView() checks only the roles and the VIEW scope, so an admin whose only grant is all-clients MANAGE fails canListClientScopes/requireListClientScopes (ClientScopesResource) and requireView (export, initial access), even though canManageClientScopes() returns true; real but narrow inconsistency.

Confirmed: getOrCreateResource never calls setType on per-client resources, so findByType("Clients") only matches the type resource and returns the name "Clients"; the only caller (AvailableRoleMappingResource) is gated on the V1 feature, which is mutually exclusive with V2, so no current path reaches it.

Correct: in V2 nothing deletes the per-client resource or its permissions when a client is removed, and this PR is what makes per-client V2 resources possible, but the impact is limited to orphaned entries named by a UUID that no longer exists.
Verified: the logger field, getEvaluationContext, and the Scope, TOKEN_EXCHANGE and ClientModelIdentity imports are unused; this is cleanup only.
Verified: the Javadoc on the void requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() says "Returns true" instead of describing the ForbiddenException; this is a docs-only issue.
